description: Creates a new item clone based on the item provided.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

destination.description: The path of a parent item under which the clone should be created.

fields.description: Extra Sitecore field names to include, e.g. ['Title']. Ignored when full is true.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

id.description: The ID of the item to be cloned. Supply this or path.

name.description: The name of the item clone.

path.description: The path of the item to be cloned. Supply this or id.

recurse.description: Adds the parameter to clone the whole branch rather than a single item.

name: common-new-item-clone
